To install, download **SteamodUpdater.apk** below and open it on your phone. You can install it over the previous version; your mod list, Workshop IDs and Steam login are kept. Your Steam password is never stored, only a login token stays on the device. If something goes wrong, open **LOG** in the app and send the exported log so it can be fixed. Steamod Updater is not affiliated with Valve or Steam.
